additional_repairs.meaning: Only actual portions reduce hunger; partial relief survives population and snapshot changes.
Goods move only against funded quantity and delivery is separate from eating.
All 3197 active decisions retain their source and original inputs.
Review matches choices separately from generated fields but settles the original complete action.
Retained dead member records do not reduce living anonymous population reserves; exactly one actual surplus portion remains sellable.

completion_scope: Known 73 audit defects and additional independently reproduced repairs, with required observations and replays completed. This is not a reality calibration or approval of every individual decision.
remaining_model_assumptions: Species survival thresholds remain scenario assumptions.
Energy, mass, water and nutrition units are not calibrated to real measurements.
Social policies and individual choices have not been validated as realistic.
Long-run evidence omits original per-decision perceptions and candidates; final dead holdings are post-estate settlement.
